title: Database Monitoring - Meta-Env Multi-DB
readme:
This is a placeholder dashboard for multi-database monitoring.

Database Infrastructure:

**Server 60 (192.168.1.60) - PostgreSQL 15.10**
- Dashboard application database
- Budget Control application
- Access: localhost:5432 only (via SSH tunnel)
- Recommended Dashboard ID: 9628 (PostgreSQL Database)

**Server 61 (192.168.1.61) - MariaDB 11.8.2**
- Production databases (READ ONLY):
  - okamih_shop (Czech e-commerce)
  - okamih_shop_sk (Slovak e-commerce)
- Test databases (FULL ACCESS):
  - okamih_shop_test
  - okamih_shop_sk_test
- Access: localhost:3306 only (via SSH tunnel)
- Credentials: User=pavel, Password=complus
- Recommended Dashboard ID: 7362 (MySQL Overview)

Import Instructions:

1. PostgreSQL Dashboard:
   - Go to Dashboards > Import
   - Enter dashboard ID: 9628
   - Select Prometheus data source
   - Configure for Server 60

2. MySQL/MariaDB Dashboard:
   - Go to Dashboards > Import
   - Enter dashboard ID: 7362
   - Select Prometheus data source
   - Configure for Server 61

Security Notes:
- Database ports are NEVER exposed externally
- Access via SSH tunnel ONLY
- Production databases are READ ONLY for monitoring
- Test databases allow full access for development

Exporter Setup:
- PostgreSQL Exporter: 192.168.1.60:9187
- MySQL Exporter: 192.168.1.61:9104

References:
- SERVERS.md: /home/user/meta-env/SERVERS.md
- Prometheus Config: /home/user/meta-env/monitoring/prometheus/prometheus.yml
